text.en: Most Canadians were born here in Canada, and that has been so since the 1800s.
text.fr: La plupart des Canadiens sont nés ici, au Canada, et c'est ainsi depuis les années 1800.

source.quote: The majority of Canadians were born in this country and this has been true since the 1800s.

verification.evidence: The majority of Canadians were born in this country and this has been true since the 1800s.

text.en: In the last 200 years, millions of newcomers have helped to build the Canadian way of life and to defend it.
text.fr: Au cours des 200 dernières années, des millions de nouveaux arrivants ont aidé à bâtir le mode de vie canadien et à le défendre.

source.quote: over the past 200 years, millions of newcomers have helped to build and defend our way of life.

verification.evidence: However, Canada is often referred to as a land of immigrants because, over the past 200 years, millions of newcomers have helped to build and defend our way of life.

text.en: People of many ethnic and religious groups live and work together peacefully, and they are proud to be Canadian.
text.fr: Des gens de nombreux groupes ethniques et religieux vivent et travaillent ensemble dans la paix, et ils sont fiers d'être canadiens.

source.quote: Many ethnic and religious groups live and work in peace as proud Canadians.

verification.evidence: Many ethnic and religious groups live and work in peace as proud Canadians.

text.en: Canada's largest ethnic groups include the English, French, Scottish and Irish. The German, Italian, Chinese, Aboriginal and Ukrainian groups are among them too, as are the Dutch, South Asian and Scandinavian groups.
text.fr: Parmi les plus grands groupes ethniques du Canada, il y a les Anglais, les Français, les Écossais et les Irlandais. Les groupes allemand, italien, chinois, autochtone et ukrainien en font aussi partie, tout comme les groupes néerlandais, sud-asiatique et scandinave.

source.quote: The largest groups are the English, French, Scottish, Irish, German, Italian, Chinese, Aboriginal, Ukrainian, Dutch, South Asian and Scandinavian.

verification.evidence: The largest groups are the English, French, Scottish, Irish, German, Italian, Chinese, Aboriginal, Ukrainian, Dutch, South Asian and Scandinavian.

text.en: Since the 1970s, most people who immigrate to Canada have come from countries in Asia.
text.fr: Depuis les années 1970, la plupart des personnes qui immigrent au Canada viennent de pays d'Asie.

source.quote: Since the 1970s, most immigrants have come from Asian countries.

verification.evidence: Since the 1970s, most immigrants have come from Asian countries.

text.en: In many Canadian homes, people speak languages other than English and French.
text.fr: Dans de nombreux foyers canadiens, on parle des langues autres que l'anglais et le français.

source.quote: Non-official languages are widely spoken in Canadian homes.

verification.evidence: Non-official languages are widely spoken in Canadian homes.

text.en: In two of Canada's biggest cities, Chinese languages are the languages spoken most at home after English.
text.fr: Dans deux des plus grandes villes du Canada, les langues chinoises sont les langues les plus parlées à la maison après l'anglais.

source.quote: Chinese languages are the second most-spoken at home, after English, in two of Canada’s biggest cities.

verification.evidence: Chinese languages are the second most-spoken at home, after English, in two of Canada’s biggest cities.

text.en: The number of people in Canada who say they have “no religion” is growing.
text.fr: Le nombre de personnes au Canada qui se déclarent « sans religion » augmente.

source.quote: as well as people who state “no religion” are also growing.

verification.evidence: The numbers of Muslims, Jews, Hindus, Sikhs and members of other religions, as well as people who state “no religion” are also growing.

text.en: Government in Canada has long worked as a partner with faith communities. Together they have supported social welfare, harmony and respect for one another. They have run schools and given health care, helped refugees start a new life, and protected freedom of religion, of religious expression and of conscience.
text.fr: Au Canada, l'État travaille depuis longtemps en partenariat avec les communautés religieuses. Ensemble, ils ont favorisé le bien-être social, l'harmonie et le respect mutuel. Ils ont tenu des écoles et offert des soins de santé, aidé des réfugiés à commencer une nouvelle vie et protégé la liberté de religion, d'expression religieuse et de conscience.

source.quote: In Canada the state has traditionally partnered with faith communities to promote social welfare, harmony and mutual respect; to provide schools and health care; to resettle refugees; and to uphold religious freedom, religious expression and freedom of conscience.

verification.evidence: In Canada the state has traditionally partnered with faith communities to promote social welfare, harmony and mutual respect; to provide schools and health care; to resettle refugees; and to uphold religious freedom, religious expression and freedom of conscience.

text.en: Gay and lesbian Canadians are fully protected by the law and treated equally under it. This includes the right to marry in a civil marriage.
text.fr: Les Canadiens gais et lesbiennes sont pleinement protégés par la loi et traités également devant elle. Cela comprend le droit de se marier civilement.

source.quote: who enjoy the full protection of and equal treatment under the law, including access to civil marriage.

verification.evidence: Canada’s diversity includes gay and lesbian Canadians, who enjoy the full protection of and equal treatment under the law, including access to civil marriage.

text.en: All these different groups share one Canadian identity. Together they form the multicultural society of Canada today.
text.fr: Tous ces groupes différents partagent une même identité canadienne. Ensemble, ils forment la société multiculturelle du Canada d'aujourd'hui.

source.quote: Together, these diverse groups, sharing a common Canadian identity, make up today’s multicultural society.

verification.evidence: Together, these diverse groups, sharing a common Canadian identity, make up today’s multicultural society.
